test_results.answer:
### High Dividend Fund 与 Asian Income Fund 2025年8月股息率比较

两个基金的 MDis 类股均旨在每月派息（派息不保证，可能从本金支付）。[ID:2][ID:14] 以下比较 2025年8月（截至29-8-2025 ex-dividend date）部分主要类别的**年化收益率（Annualized yield）**：

| 类别示例                  | High Dividend Fund (Aug 2025) | Asian Income Fund (Aug 2025) |
|---------------------------|-------------------------------|------------------------------|
| USD MDis/Unhedged MDis   | Class A2 USD MDis: 5.0%      | Class A USD Unhedged MDis: 5.0% [ID:2] |
| HKD MDis/Unhedged MDis   | Class A2 HKD MDis: 5.0%      | Class A HKD Unhedged MDis: 5.0% [ID:2] |
| AUD Hedged MDis          | Class A2 AUD Hedged MDis: 4.2% | Class A AUD Hedged MDis: 4.2% [ID:2] |
| CAD Hedged MDis          | Class A2 CAD Hedged MDis: 4.6% | Class A CAD Hedged MDis: 4.7% [ID:2] |
| NZD Hedged MDis          | Class A2 NZD Hedged MDis: 6.2% | Class A NZD Hedged MDis: 5.1% [ID:2] |
| RMB Hedged MDis          | Class A2 RMB Hedged MDis: 3.2% | Class A RMB Hedged MDis: 2.5% [ID:2] |
| RMB Unhedged MDis        | Class A2 RMB Unhedged MDis: 5.1% | Class A RMB Unhedged MDis: 5.0% [ID:2] |

**关键观察**：
- **相似点**：USD/HKD 类年化收益率相同（约5.0%），AUD/CAD Hedged 类接近。[ID:2][ID:14]
- **差异点**：High Dividend Fund 的 NZD Hedged 类较高（6.2% vs 5.1%），RMB Hedged 类稍高（3.2% vs 2.5%）。High Dividend Fund 还有更多类如 Class B USD MDIS (4.9%)。[ID:2][ID:14]
- High Dividend Fund 整体覆盖更多货币类，收益率范围更广（3.2%-6.2%），而 Asian Income Fund 集中在4.2%-5.1%。[ID:2][ID:14]

年化收益率计算公式：(最新股息金额 / ex-dividend date NAV) × 12。[ID:0][ID:2]

The investment objective of the Asian Income Fund is consistent across multiple monthly reports:  
**"The Fund aims to maximize return and income by investing in Asian equities, Asian fixed income securities and other assets relating to Asian companies that are listed in Asia, or have registered offices in Asia or generate a predominant share of their sales and/or their profits in Asia. The Fund also aims to achieve lower portfolio volatility by actively screening and selecting a combination of lower volatility equities and fixed income securities."**[ID:0][ID:1][ID:2][ID:3][ID:4][ID:5][ID:6][ID:7][ID:8]
